$comment: Where an app stores ids inside its settings, and of what. Copying things (duplicating an app, pasting widgets, restoring a version) gives them new ids and rewrites these values to point at the copies. A new widget prop type or workflow setting that holds an id MUST be listed here, or copies keep pointing at the originals. Read by the backend (catalog/IdReferences.java) and the editor (core/catalog/id-references.ts). Kinds: widget, page, pageList (a JSON array of page ids), dataSource.
